raw.text:
As an archivist, my mindset is naturally oriented toward long-term preservation, systematic preparedness, and safeguarding the future against systemic risks. While immediate flood relief addresses a critical present crisis, investing in long-term pandemic-preparedness research aligns with a methodical approach to preventing future, potentially global catastrophes and preserving the continuity of human history and society. 

I will commit my choice to Option 1.
